tuned_on: fold 1 only (train 2021-22 + 2022-23, test 2023-24); inner split = last 20% of fold-1 training games by date; inner L0s fit on the inner-training rows; EN rows excluded from the booster
selection: D27 form (D29 / D30): among cells whose inner LL per game is within 2 SE (paired game-block bootstrap, 1,000) of the best cell, the smallest max(|log for|, |log against|) of the fold-1 ES spread ratios (cell refit on all fold-1 training rows at its rounds, predicting 2023-24); ties within 0.02 to the fewer num_leaves x rounds
